checkScope: Image decoding, uniqueness, dimensions and package identity only; selection JS syntax checked separately. No browser, Android, inference, usability or performance acceptance.
imageReview: Inspect each raw image separately before publication; AI text/material fidelity is a visual-review concern.

visualReview.method: Assistant visual inspection of every original image
visualReview.scope: Distinct visual direction, visible main controls, dark theme, brand-reference resemblance and readable model rows
visualReview.limitations: AI rendering is not a pixel-accurate interface; production typography, asset reuse and narrow-screen layout remain pending.
